items.title: Emile Barnes and Paul Barnes Interview, 1959-10-01
items.q: Well Dave Nelson made some arrangements for King Oliver.

ctx.x: I believe I heard it, Dave Nelson.

Yeah, Dave Nelson. Well Dave Nelson made some arrangements for King Oliver. He did arrangements. Well during that time I was playing with Jelero Martin. And that was up until 1929, or the middle of 1929, Jelero Martin had a failure. His band from New York, he had a wonderful band, one of the best I've ever played with. They wouldn't go so we got different men and it's a long story but what we went through. But that's the last I know of Jelero Martin. That was in 1929. I don't think he lived much longer after that.
He went I think down to Washington, different places.
